integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo standard Schwarz lemma, elementary planar geometry and unilateral-shift numerical range. Python checks are supplementary finite tests, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns integer order m>=2 and the standard Szego kernel of the disk, determining the closed convex envelope rather than every exact Berezin range. Boundary arc values are generally limiting, not attained. No independently audited proof or exhaustive check of unindexed literature.
title: Sharp universal Szegő-quotient convex envelopes for higher-order disk zeros
